central_belt_kelpies_guide.text: The Kelpies are thirty metres tall, made of stainless steel, and were unveiled in 2013. They stand in Helix Park beside the canal.
Sculptor Andy Scott based them on two real Clydesdale horses, Duke and Baron.
In the old tales a kelpie is a water spirit who lures travellers. Ours only lure photographers.

central_belt_kelpies_horseman.text: Clydesdales get their name from Clydesdale, the valley of the Clyde. They pulled barges, ploughs and carts, and they are very good at being enormous.
